summary: Orphan cleanup rechecks authority per point and never reports unconfirmed deletes or drops protection; Forget is serialized against cleanup and detaches first; delete markers, mountpoints and plaintext SMB credential files are cleaned up.

guide.reason: The backup guide must say NFS repositories need no_root_squash, Forget can be refused while a cleanup runs or a mount cannot be removed, and a lost credential key is recovered by Forgetting and registering again. The edit is assigned to the guide owner.

api.reason: New refusal and result texts only: repository forget, orphan cleanup and orphan query keep their endpoints and fields.

roadmap.reason: Bug fixes; no milestone or acceptance gate changes.

state.record: Repository records, catalog, orphan cleanup records and credential receipts on the pool master's Nex Core.
state.reason: No new state; a fresh Controller reads the same records through the existing inventory.

verification.method: Focused Go tests in internal/agent and internal/vmhost; no lab run.
